Metadata.CommitMsg:
Post merge fixes for #3720

1. Null fields on edit: initializeForm now turns null into '' for every
   text field, so the edit page no longer crashes on addresses without a
   zip code or street.
2. Length errors: zip code and street address now show a mat-error
   (MAX_TEXTAREA_LENGTH) when they are too long.
3. Double submit: the Submit button is also disabled while saving
   (addressForm().submitting()).
4. Failed save: the catch in save() no longer calls resetForm(), so the
   user's input survives a server error. I rewrote the two existing
   tests that expected the form to be cleared; they now check that the
   values are kept.
5. Mobile number range: the minimum is now 1000000, matching the server
   and the error text. The range in the error message is built from the
   same constants.
6. Address list reload: AddressComponent.load() now goes through a
   Subject with switchMap, catchError and takeUntilDestroyed, like the
   review fix in f1312b0. load() is still public, so RecycleComponent
   keeps working.
7. Edit route: paramMap now uses switchMap into getById with
   takeUntilDestroyed, so a late response for an old id can't overwrite
   the form. A failed getById is now logged.
8. Dead code: removed addressId and getMessage from
   AddressSelectComponent, plus their spec case.
9. Duplicated SCSS: the page sizing moved into address.component.scss as
   :host(.page-card). Both pages already set that class, but nothing
   used it before. The two page stylesheets now contain only
   .center-container. I left that class duplicated, because almost every
   page component in the repo has its own copy and moving it would go
   beyond this change.
10. Shared schema: new file
    frontend/src/app/Models/address-form.schema.ts holds
    AddressFormModel, addressFormSchema and the limit constants. The
    template now uses those constants instead of hard-coded 8, 160 and
    the range string.

Signed-off-by: Jannik Hollenbach <jannik.hollenbach@owasp.org>

Misconfigurations.Title: ':latest' tag used
Misconfigurations.Description: When using a 'FROM' statement you should use a specific tag to avoid uncontrolled behavior when the image is updated.
Misconfigurations.Message: Specify a tag in the 'FROM' statement for image 'gcr.io/distroless/nodejs24-debian13'
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Add a tag to the image in the 'FROM' statement

Misconfigurations.Title: No HEALTHCHECK defined
Misconfigurations.Description: You should add HEALTHCHECK instruction in your docker container images to perform the health check on running containers.
Misconfigurations.Message: Add HEALTHCHECK instruction in your Dockerfile
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Add HEALTHCHECK instruction in Dockerfile

Misconfigurations.Title: EFS Encryption has not been enabled
Misconfigurations.Description: If your organization is subject to corporate or regulatory policies that require encryption of data and metadata at rest, we recommend creating a file system that is encrypted at rest, and mounting your file system using encryption of data in transit.
Misconfigurations.Message: File system is not encrypted.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Enable encryption for EFS

Misconfigurations.Title: Load balancers should drop invalid headers
Misconfigurations.Description:
Passing unknown or invalid headers through to the target poses a potential risk of compromise.
By setting drop_invalid_header_fields to true, anything that does not conform to well known, defined headers will be removed by the load balancer.
Misconfigurations.Message: Application load balancer is not set to drop invalid headers.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set drop_invalid_header_fields to true

Misconfigurations.Title: Load balancer is exposed to the internet.
Misconfigurations.Description: There are many scenarios in which you would want to expose a load balancer to the wider internet, but this check exists as a warning to prevent accidental exposure of internal assets. You should ensure that this resource should be exposed publicly.
Misconfigurations.Message: Load balancer is exposed publicly.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Switch to an internal load balancer or add a tfsec ignore

Misconfigurations.Title: Use of plain HTTP.
Misconfigurations.Description:
Plain HTTP is unencrypted and human-readable. This means that if a malicious actor was to eavesdrop on your connection, they would be able to see all of your data flowing back and forth.
You should use HTTPS, which is HTTP over an encrypted (TLS) connection, meaning eavesdroppers cannot read your traffic.
Misconfigurations.Message: Listener for application load balancer does not use HTTPS.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Switch to HTTPS to benefit from TLS security features

Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set a more restrictive cidr range

Misconfigurations.Title: VPC Flow Logs is a feature that enables you to capture information about the IP traffic going to and from network interfaces in your VPC. Misconfigurations.Description: VPC Flow Logs provide visibility into network traffic that traverses the VPC and can be used to detect anomalous traffic or insight during security workflows.
Misconfigurations.Message: VPC does not have VPC Flow Logs enabled.
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Enable flow logs for VPC

Misconfigurations.Title: ':latest' tag used
Misconfigurations.Description: When using a 'FROM' statement you should use a specific tag to avoid uncontrolled behavior when the image is updated.
Misconfigurations.Message: Specify a tag in the 'FROM' statement for image 'alpine'
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Add a tag to the image in the 'FROM' statement

Misconfigurations.Title: Image user should not be 'root'
Misconfigurations.Description: Running containers with 'root' user can lead to a container escape situation. It is a best practice to run containers as non-root users, which can be done by adding a 'USER' statement to the Dockerfile.
Misconfigurations.Message: Specify at least 1 USER command in Dockerfile with non-root user as argument
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Add 'USER <non root user name>' line to the Dockerfile

Misconfigurations.Title: 'apk add' is missing '--no-cache'
Misconfigurations.Description: You should use 'apk add' with '--no-cache' to clean package cached data and reduce image size.
Misconfigurations.Message: '--no-cache' is missed: apk add curl
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Add '--no-cache' to 'apk add' in Dockerfile

Misconfigurations.Title: No HEALTHCHECK defined
Misconfigurations.Description: You should add HEALTHCHECK instruction in your docker container images to perform the health check on running containers.
Misconfigurations.Message: Add HEALTHCHECK instruction in your Dockerfile
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Add HEALTHCHECK instruction in Dockerfile
